line.en: the christmas season at tivoli runs 13 november to 3 january, with later closing on fridays and saturdays. the lit tree and the rides are the thing to see; check tivoli.dk for the day's hours and the ticket price.
line.de: die weihnachtszeit im tivoli läuft vom 13. november bis 3. januar, freitags und samstags länger geöffnet. der leuchtende baum und die fahrgeschäfte sind das richtige ziel; die tageszeiten und den eintrittspreis auf tivoli.dk prüfen.
line.tr: tivoli'nin noel sezonu 13 kasım ile 3 ocak arası sürüyor, cuma ve cumartesileri daha geç kapanıyor. ışıklı ağaç ve atlıkarıncalar asıl görülecek yer; günlük saatleri ve giriş ücretini tivoli.dk'den kontrol et.

sparks.why: Tivoli Christmas season 13 Nov 2026 to 3 Jan 2027, with later Friday and Saturday closing, per Visit Copenhagen and several travel guides; the day's hours were not checked on tivoli.dk.
